failureModes.description: Returns a final answer while a required call, retry, or final-state change remains incomplete.
One or more required tool calls were absent or did not use the exact required input.
Performs a required step before its evidence or policy dependencies are ready.
Receives a retryable tool error but never completes the same call successfully.
The final business state is missing one or more exact required changes.
Escalates unnecessarily or fails to escalate when human action is required.
